verdict.rationale: Scheduling automation is a fair axis for a release-management platform, and the evidence lists scheduled flag changes and progressive rollouts, which advance flag changes automatically over time. These are scoped to flag changes rather than general recurring jobs or workflows, and the evidence consists of doc titles with no detail. Missing for 10: recurring (cron-style) schedules, general workflow scheduling beyond flag changes, any detail on how schedules work, agent/API-driven scheduling, independent or hands-on corroboration.
